goal: Test whether a small weighted cheek web can visually attach the trial mandible to the skull through opening poses
steps: Built two thin side cheek bands, weighted from upper skull to jaw.
Rendered idle and attack poses, including the extreme action01 frame25.
observations: The flat patches read as cardboard flaps and cannot substitute for a cheek/temporal volume with edge flow around the jaw joint.
Bone02 translation is near zero in the problematic action01 frames; the visually displaced jaw comes from rotation and missing connective anatomy.

hinge remains coherent in action01 frame25
